prompts.en: Last season, what did you plant on this land?
prompts.ms: Musim lepas, tanam apa kat kebun ni?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard you planted {label} last season. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar musim lepas tanam {label}. Betul ke?

prompts.en: When there is no rain, do you still have water to water this field?
prompts.ms: Kalau tak hujan, ada air lagi tak untuk siram kebun ni?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard that when there is no rain, water is: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar kalau tak hujan, air untuk siram {label}. Betul ke?

prompts.en: For your next crop, what matters most to you: saving water, keeping the soil healthy, earning more, or avoiding big losses?
prompts.ms: Untuk pusingan ni, apa yang paling penting: nak jimat air, bagi tanah subur balik, cari untung lebih, atau nak elak rugi?

confirmation_templates.en: So your main goal right now is: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Jadi yang paling penting sekarang ialah {label}. Betul ke?

prompts.en: Did this field flood at all last season?
prompts.ms: Musim lepas, kebun ni pernah naik air atau banjir tak?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard regarding flooding last season: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar musim lepas kebun ni {label}. Betul ke?

prompts.en: After heavy rain, how long does water stay sitting on the field?
prompts.ms: Lepas hujan lebat, air bertakung lama mana kat kebun?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard water stays on the field for: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar lepas hujan lebat, air bertakung {label}. Betul ke?

prompts.en: When the soil is wet, how does it feel in your hand — sticky like clay, loose and sandy, or in-between?
prompts.ms: Bila tanah tu basah, pegang rasa macam mana — melekit macam tanah liat, berpasir, atau sedang-sedang?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard the wet soil feels: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar tanah ni bila basah rasa {label}. Betul ke?

prompts.en: Have you had the soil tested recently?
prompts.ms: Pernah buat ujian tanah tak baru-baru ni?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard about your soil test: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar pasal ujian tanah: {label}. Betul ke?

labels.en: Yes, and I know the result
Yes, but I don't remember the result
labels.ms: Pernah buat, tapi tak ingat keputusan

prompts.en: What gives you the most trouble in this field: bugs, plant disease, weeds, too much water, or not enough water?
prompts.ms: Selalu kat kebun ni, apa masalah paling kerap jadi: serangga perosak, penyakit pokok, rumput banyak, terlebih air, atau tak cukup air?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard the biggest trouble in the field is: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar masalah paling kerap kat kebun ialah {label}. Betul ke?

prompts.en: Which part of the field usually gives you the most headache?
prompts.ms: Bahagian mana kat kebun ni yang selalu buat hal?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard the problem spot is: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar bahagian yang selalu bermasalah ialah {label}. Betul ke?

prompts.en: When it's time to plant and harvest, will you have enough hands to help?
prompts.ms: Nanti masa nak tanam dengan nak tuai, cukup orang tak nak buat kerja?

confirmation_templates.en: I heard about your helpers/workers: {label}. Is that right?
confirmation_templates.ms: Saya dengar pasal orang nak kerja kat kebun: {label}. Betul ke?
